Gradient descent, step by step

Each iteration: evaluate F at the point → measure the slopes → take a small step against the slope. Repeat until the slopes are ≈ 0.

MAIN VIEW · whole surface (stays fixed)

ZOOMED VIEW

THE NUMBERS

F(x,y) = 0.25x⁴ − x² + 0.3x + 0.25y⁴ − 0.8y² + 0.15y
step size μ = 0.2

Keyboard: ← / → to step, space to play or pause.
